_comment: The deep-scan router (#544): TF-IDF + logistic regression, chosen
over a 151 MB ModernBERT that scored the same on the same haystack.
Features are word 1-2 grams; tf is sublinear (1+log count); the
vector is l2-normalised before the linear model, exactly as
scikit-learn's TfidfVectorizer does. Trained on PAN12 predator vs
PAN12 ordinary and C-SSRS at-risk vs C-SSRS supportive — no corpus
text is reproduced here, only per-term weights.
